behavior: A press can open the popup of `Menu.Trigger`, `Select.Trigger` or `Combobox.Trigger`. The popup then stays open when the release comes within 8 px of the point of the press on each axis. This is also true when the trigger moved. The trigger opens its popup in the frame after the press, and a layout change in that frame can move the trigger. The release of a press that did not move then lands on another element. Base UI closes the popup for that release with the reason `cancel-open`. Base UI also closes the popup for a release more than 5 px off a trigger that did not move. Vase UI keeps the popup open for such a release when it is within 8 px of the press. A move of 8 px or less on each axis is not a drag. `Select.Item` of Base UI takes 8 px of vertical travel as the start of a drag. 8 px is less than half of the 24 px target of WCAG 2.2. A person whose hand moves 8 px or less on each axis thus keeps the popup. A release still closes the popup when it is more than 8 px from the point of the press on one axis. The release must also be off the popup and more than 5 px off the trigger.
